name: Google Cloud CLI
description: Installs the Google Cloud CLI (`gcloud`) into the workspace and provides a settings panel for project/account defaults and optional service-account JSON setup.

gcloud_project.description: Default Google Cloud project (`gcloud config set project`).

gcloud_account.description: Default Google account or service account email (`gcloud config set account`).

gcloud_compute_region.description: Default Compute Engine region (`gcloud config set compute/region`).

gcloud_compute_zone.description: Default Compute Engine zone (`gcloud config set compute/zone`).

gcloud_service_account_json.description: Optional service-account key JSON. Stored in the zero-knowledge secret store and activated with `gcloud auth activate-service-account`.
